title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 86 (Punishment for charge contravention)

content.overview: If a company defaults in complying with any provision of the chapter on registration of charges, the company is liable to a penalty of ₹5,00,000 and every officer in default to ₹50,000. A person who wilfully furnishes false/incorrect information or knowingly suppresses material information required to be registered under section 77 is liable to action under section 447.
content.glance: If a company defaults in complying with any provision of the chapter on registration of charges, the company is liable to a penalty of ₹5,00,000 and every officer in default to ₹50,000. A person who wilfully furnishes false/incorrect information or knowingly suppresses material information required to be registered under section 77 is liable to action under section 447.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 86 (Punishment for contravention). Under subsection (1), if a company defaults in complying with any provision of the chapter on registration of charges, the company is liable to a penalty of ₹5,00,000 and every officer in default is liable to a penalty of ₹50,000. Under subsection (2), a person who wilfully furnishes false or incorrect information, or knowingly suppresses material information required to be registered under section 77, is liable to action under section 447. These are distinct routes: the general chapter-default penalty and the separate false-information/fraud cross-reference. Legal verification remains open.
